intent: Keep Customer, Admin, and Caretaker workflows connected through verified records, explicit approvals, durable evidence, and least-privilege access.
productRules: FarmConnect must never present payment, ownership, care, sale, or withdrawal as complete until every required downstream record exists.
Customer-visible status must be derived from authoritative workflow records, not optimistic UI state.
Admin decisions and Caretaker work must preserve evidence, actor, timestamp, and related-record linkage.
KaFarm may explain and recommend from evidence but may not silently redefine FarmConnect business intent.
uxRules: Customer pages explain the current state, required next step, and official evidence result.
Admin queues show only actionable records and move reviewed records out of the open queue.
Caretaker tasks show the exact rooster, procedure, safety guidance, proof requirements, and inventory quantities.
Errors must be visible and actionable; a failed action may not look successful.
visualRules: Preserve FarmConnect visual identity and readable hierarchy across desktop, tablet, and phone.
Do not expose credentials, PINs, private KYC values, payout identifiers, or service-role secrets.
Use consistent status language and do not use success colors for unverified states.

farmBuy: Payment submission creates a review request, not ownership.
Approved payment must create the expected inventory or rooster ownership record exactly once.
careRequests: A paid and approved request moves to Task Management for assignment.
Approved proof must release the linked customer Care Log and reconcile actual inventory use.
carePlans: A paid active Care Plan generates one authorized daily mission for the assigned Caretaker.
Unpaid customers still receive daily standard guidance but no automatic paid caretaker mission.
Reserved supplies are deducted only from verified actual use and never twice.
careLogs: Only approved proof becomes an official customer-visible Care Log.
sellRequest: No sale price is guaranteed before inspection and Admin review.
A completed sale must reconcile ownership release, evidence, and wallet ledger exactly once.
wallet: Wallet balance is derived from an auditable ledger; KaFarm must never manufacture credit.
withdrawals: Withdrawal eligibility requires approved KYC and the configured security controls.
Completed withdrawal requires payout proof, ledger consistency, and customer Inbox evidence.
kyc: KYC decisions are Admin-only and private evidence must remain access controlled.
Approved KYC must reconcile with the customer profile verification state.
caretaker: Caretaker access requires an active approved role.
Submitted work must not become complete before required proof and Admin review.
support: Sensitive identity, money, ownership, fraud, or security concerns escalate to an Admin.

securityRules: Re-authenticate and re-authorize every KaFarm API request as an active FarmConnect Admin.
Use server-only data access and return minimized DTOs.
Never give the model a service-role key, raw credential, unrestricted SQL, or generic mutation tool.
Treat runtime input, route parameters, tool arguments, and model output as untrusted.
